neighbours.label: image- and video-editing software and their edits (Photoshop, photoshopped, Premiere, Lightroom, GIMP, colour grading); text editing and plain photography stay quiet
fire: The designer touched up the product shots in Photoshop before sending them out.
Critics said the magazine cover had been photoshopped to hide her wrinkles.
He learned colour grading and video editing while making short films at college.
The wedding video was cut in Adobe Premiere over the weekend.
She adjusted the exposure of the landscape photos in Lightroom.
Our club teaches beginners how to remove backgrounds in Photoshop.
The free program GIMP can do most of the same photo retouching.
The fake picture was so badly photoshopped that the shadows pointed different ways.
quiet: The designer printed the product shots before sending them out.
Critics said the magazine cover was dull and the headline was too long.
He learned to write scripts while making short films at college.
The wedding video was recorded on two cameras over the weekend.
She took the landscape photos at dawn from the top of the hill.
Our club teaches beginners how to hold a camera steady.
The newspaper editor corrected the grammar in every article.
The old picture was so faded that the faces were hard to see.
